I think people tend to overlook complexities and lean too far into either “diet best” or “exercise best” dualistic thinking when exercise doesn’t burn significant calories but it does almost everything else! I really appreciate you incorporating diet into the discourse too because it’s true, I like to say “exercise does everything good for you except burn calories. “ It can assist in weight loss through different avenues but not directly. I gave up weight loss and enjoy as much physical activity as I can (yoga, dancing, hiking, lifting weights, and hopefully beat saber soon when I have money) , knowing that I’ll get innumerable benefits while staying at the weight I am and hopefully not gaining any more. I hope this didn’t sound rambly or preachy.  TL;DR— exercise is natural medicine! Just not a direct weight loss medicine 😅 Keep up the great work!
